ai_summary: Bajaj Healthcare Limited's 33rd Annual General Meeting confirmed clean statutory and secretarial audit reports for FY 2025-26, indicating sound financial health and compliance. Shareholders approved the adoption of financial statements and declared a final dividend of ₹1.50 per equity share, alongside routine re-appointments and remuneration approvals for a non-executive director and the cost auditor. No material red flags were identified in the proceedings.
